Work that moved a decision.

Straight-line vs. routed access — same two points
Flagship · Research

Ghana Healthcare Accessibility Analysis

Ghana has 9,978 health facilities across 260 districts — but "nearest clinic" and "reachable clinic" are two different things. I routed 2.7 billion origin-destination pairs to find out which is which. The answer changes which districts actually need investment first.

PythonOSRMSeleniumD3.jsVoronoi tessellationChoropleth / GeoJSON

Machine learning · Health

Cancer type prediction from gene expression

A five-way cancer classifier — breast, renal, lung, prostate, colon — built straight from raw RNA-seq gene expression data most people wouldn't know how to touch. Logistic Regression and XGBoost both hit near-perfect separation (F1 0.99–1.0), stress-tested with stratified k-fold and confusion-matrix checks so the number could actually be trusted. Built to support earlier diagnosis, faster.

Research · MSc thesis

XGNN-MisD — explainable GNN for misinformation detection

A Graph Attention Network paired with a Concept Bottleneck Model, so the network reasons through human-interpretable concepts by design — not a post-hoc explanation attached after the fact.
